author: GamingBolt
description:
Okay. Deep breath. We’re on part 15 of our recap of the Resident Evil series, and here, we’re going to talk about the colossal mess that is Resident Evil 6. Don’t get us wrong- there are things to like about the game, primarily among them being the fact that it is straight up just a really fun action game and a great co-op experience (though that does come at the cost of the series’ horror roots). 

But where its story is concerned, RE6 is nothing short of a complete mess. We are, however, going to do our best to present it as cohesively as possible.
title: Was Resident Evil 6's Story Really Bad? - Before You Play Resident Evil 9 Requiem

author: GamingBolt
description:
With everything that's happened to the once vengeance filled, monster and demon destroyer, narrowing down the exact moment he became broken is tough. Fortunately,  PlayStation and Sony Santa Monica have outlined exactly that with Sons of Sparta, a 2D action side-scrolling prequel to the main series. 

The story primarily unfolds through an older Kratos, sitting by a tree with his daughter, Calliope. Lysandra, her mother, sent her to be punished for ignoring her chores, helping a fellow Spartan named Ismene and saying ugly things.
title: God of War: Sons of Sparta Ending Explained And How It Connects With Other Games

author: GamingBolt
description:
With Resident Evil Requiem very close to its final release, we began to think about how it’s shaping up to be a tribute to the features of the games that came before it. Grace and Leon’s latest adventures share a lot in common with the action-focused as well as survival-focused gameplay loops that the franchise has had, blending them so seamlessly into a single story that it just works. 

That balance has been very interesting to us for a variety of reasons. Join as we look beyond RE2 and RE1 to see how Requiem has woven in the best into an experience that we're beginning to see as a  anniversary bash.
title: Resident Evil Requiem Somehow Feels Like Every Resident Evil At Once
